historical_record.description: In June 1979 the building was an eighteen-room rooming house on a lot of 5,500 square feet.
The City Planning Commission voted 4-2 to authorize converting the building, an eighteen-room rooming house, into three dwelling units with two parking spaces in its basement (Resolution 8293).
